population.label: World population (UN projection)
population.hint: How many people the world will feed depends on choices families make, shaped by education, health care and access to voluntary family planning. These are the UN's projections, not a lever: the levers' effect is measured against the future you pick.

chart.title: World population
chart.label: Line chart of world population from {from} to {end}: counted and estimated, then the UN's three projections
chart.caption: People to feed. Population does not cause the warming above; it sets how much food is needed, and so farming's emissions in the baseline.
chart.inconsistent: The UN's {variant} projection tells a different story from {ssp}, whose own population is {direction}; the rest of the world's emissions stay the scenario's.
chart.notApplied: With the SSP2 path for farm emissions, the population chosen changes nothing.
